function.name: get_protein_sequence
function.description: Retrieve the protein sequence encoded by a human gene. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

species.description: The species for which the gene is to be analyzed.

function.name: route_estimate_time
function.description: Estimate the travel time for a specific route with optional stops. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The starting point for the journey.

stops.description: Additional cities or points of interest to stop at during the journey. Default is an empty array.

function.name: lawsuit_check_case
function.description: Verify the details of a lawsuit case and check its status using case ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

case_id.description: The identification number of the lawsuit case.

closed_status.description: The status of the lawsuit case to be verified.
